description:
You are a registered nurse on a cardiac step-down unit. Patient Rosario Ortiz (DOB: 1944-06-15) is being admitted prior to initiating anticoagulation therapy for newly diagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Three documentation tasks must be completed before anticoagulants can be started:

1. The patient has a known severe allergy to Aspirin — she experienced anaphylaxis during a prior NSAID exposure. Add this to her allergy record: Allergen: Aspirin, Reaction: Anaphylaxis, Severity: Severe.

2. Record the following 0800 admission vitals: Blood Pressure 148/90 mmHg, Weight 87 kg, Pulse 92 bpm, Temperature 37.4°C. An active visit has been started for this patient.

3. The nephrology consult confirmed her Chronic kidney disease (stage 3a) must be on her active problem list — it affects anticoagulant dosing and is currently absent. Add it as a Confirmed condition.

Complete all three tasks for Rosario Ortiz. Login: admin / Admin123. OpenMRS: http://localhost/openmrs/spa
